messages: Maya: heads up - we're seeing a p99 decode tail jump on prod in us-west-2 since the kernel rollout at 10:02. p95 up modestly, but p99 and streaming stalls are spiking. customers hitting streaming timeouts. Ops-Bot: incident CREATED #INC-2026: high decode tail latency (p99) in us-west-2, affected services: streaming/generation, severity: P1. tags: paging, kernel-rollout. Karan: I'm on it. logs show a sudden rise in page-faults and KV eviction churn on hosts running the new trt8.2 kernel + flashattn patch. sample: "EVICT_RATE 12k/s, pagefaults ↑ 5x". Tess: @Karan any rollback plan? DeployBot: deployment 2026-11-08-22:02: trt8.2.1 + compile-opts: -O3 -falign-functions rolled to pool-a. Maya: customer-impact list attached in the CS ticket, some latency-sensitive customers seeing stream stalls and disconnects, Evan-CS is tracking. Evan-CS: confirmed two customers with >=50% degraded success rates on streaming ops. They're asking for ETA. Jordan: can we divert traffic to fallback model variant with older kernel? Karan: yes, we have a compatible variant pinned to trt8.1. We'll need a routing policy change - can do gradual shift. Tess: immediate mitigations we should try: 1) enable KV prefix caching for heavy-call routes; 2) lower max_batch_tokens for streaming to reduce compaction pauses; 3) rollback kernel in the worst hosts. Karan: running a quick host-level check to identify nodes with worst page fault counts: `ssh root@node-1 'dmesg | grep -i page'` output shows repeated mmap faults on decode_worker threads. Maya: also seeing a small bump in memory fragmentation metrics. might be an allocator/align issue from the new compile flag. Karan: flag suspicion: new compilepath introduced -falign-functions=64 in the build, which changes code layout causing worse working set for flashattn kernels. I'm going to test a rollback on a single zone. DeployBot: initiated rollback: queueing rollback job for pool-a hosts (subset). Ops-Bot: action logged: rollback queued by Karan at 10:15. Jordan: while rollback proceeds, can we adjust routing? I can push a routing rule to divert 30% streaming traffic to us-west-1 and the trt8.1 variant. Tess: please do. We want minimal blast radius. Jordan: pushing rule now: `redwood route update --service streaming --percent 30 --target us-west-1 --model-variant trt8.1` ... done. Jordan: 3% latency improvement seen in the first 30s on our canary dashboards. Maya: good. Karan: rollback on 3 out of 20 faulty hosts completed, those hosts show eviction rate back to baseline and streaming stalls dropped. Still a few hosts lagging. Ops-Bot: monitor rule: p99 trending down from 2.8s -> 1.4s in affected pool after rollback partial. Evan-CS: relaying to customers: "we've detected elevated streaming latency, we've routed traffic to fallback variants and are rolling back a kernel change. ETA 30-60m for full mitigation." Tess: also enabling autoshrink on problematic services temporarily to reduce concurrent working set. Command: `infractl service update streaming --autoshrink on` Jordan: after divert + partial rollback + autoshrink, incident rate for streaming success events dropped by 60%. Karan: root cause hypothesis: compilepath + align flag changed code placement which increases page residency for flashattn fused kernels, triggering KV eviction cascades at high concurrency. Need a reproducible test. I'm spinning a repro with trace-level logs and perf maps. Maya: good, prioritize a test that reproduces eviction cascade with synthetic workload matching production token distributions. Karan: repro job started against a staging cluster with trt8.2.1+flags, waiting for output. Ops-Bot: note: increased pager noise in last 15m, keeping channel open. Tess: FYI I alerted runtime team and build owners; we'll need a hotpatch to remove the align flag in the next build if repro confirms. Jordan: can we schedule a canary rollback across all pool-a hosts if p99 doesn't settle? Karan: yes; plan: if p99 > 1.8s for next 15m, roll back pool-a completely. Maya: agreed. Evan-CS: customers asking for postmortem items and whether any requests were lost. We're seeing timeouts but not data-corruption. please capture timeline and any request failures for SLAs. Karan: logging all request failures to an incident bucket: s3://incidents/5178901234/ request-failures.log. will share. Tess: bookkeeping: create a follow-up ticket for build team to audit compile flags and add kernel/flashattn compatibility tests in CI. Maya: I'm handing off to Karan for active mitigation; I'll update leadership and CS. Ops-Bot: incident UPDATED: severity remains P1; next status check in 10m. Karan: continuing mitigation, will post when rollback completes or p99 normalizes. final note before handoff: if rollback doesn't fully eliminate p99 spikes, we may need to revert the flashattn fused kernel and revert the trt upgrade. leaving channel open for next shift. Maya: thanks everyone, handing to night oncall (Tess) at 10:30 - please escalate to runtime leads if we cross thresholds. :raised_hands:
